articles.title: Presley Gerber's Ex Shares Heartwarming Tribute To Model Amid Cremation Mystery: 'Wide Open Heart'
articles.description: Presley Gerber’s ex-girlfriend Cameron Rorrison has broken her silence following the model's tragic death at the age of 27, sharing an emotional tribute that is now drawing fresh attention amid unanswered questions surrounding his final days. Cameron, who dated Presley from 2018 to 2020, admitted she had a “difficult time finding the words” before describing him as having a “wide open heart,” inspiring compassion and an incredible understanding of others. She called his humanity “honest and pure” and ultimately remembered him as an “angel in this life.” Cameron ended her message by writing, “I hope you can feel the outpouring of love up there Pres.” Other former girlfriends, including Lexi Wood and Charlotte D’Alessio, have also shared emotional tributes. Presley died at a Santa Monica sober living facility, and police are investigating the death as a suspected overdose.

articles.description: Sylvester Stallone, the Hollywood star who famously embodied the warrior spirit through 'Rambo', has made a striking admission about war. Stallone’s comments come against the backdrop of Donald Trump’s ongoing conflict with Iran.
